text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today's the day of the Fan Fest—a huge
sporting
event wherein Tracen Academy
opens its doors to
fans of all ages.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Races are important, but the Fan Fest is
a big
deal too! We've gotta make the
most of the
celebrations and have lots of
fun. ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Well, the sport that's most
compatible with
feng shui would be...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Using this logic, Copano Rickey ends up

choosing...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Rickey! ☆ Lucky! ☆ Cheer squad! I'll
lead my team
to victory with feng shui
cheers!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems she'll be on a cheer team
instead of one
of the sports teams. And
it looks like she won't be
doing it alone.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Let me guess—you could use a hand?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Very well, Rickey. If you're serious about
this, I
shall demonstrate the mindset of a
first-rate
cheerleader for you.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry, Nature, King. Feng shui
cheering isn't
really like that.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's less about cheering and more about
taking
control of the space around you.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So these two are gonna be helping me
out!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Um... What are we supposed to do?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: A cheer squad? Now that's marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the left is Manhattan Cafe. She's a
mysterious
Umamusume who's rumored
to be haunted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the right is Marvelous Sunday. She
adores
anything marvelous, and is on a
mission to inject
that energy into every
aspect of her life.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep. With me in the lead and these
two in
just the right positions...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
There's no contest we can't win! Can I
count on
you two to go where I tell you?

text_block_list.name: Cafe and Marvelous
text_block_list.text:
...Okay.
Sure! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The soccer game begins before long,
but...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Okay, first is Xun. I'll position Manhattan
Cafe
behind the home goal, facing
southeast.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The players on the other team... are
coming this
way? If they score a goal...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...That's not happening. Not ever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: OOOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Opposition Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Wh-what the heck is that?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Next up is Qian. I'll position Marvelous
Sunday to
the side of the opposition's
goal, facing
northwest.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Fweep, fweep, fweep! ☆ Fweep, fweep, fweep! ♪ I'm in a marvelous mood! ★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Shoot, shoot, marvelous! Goal after goal!

Marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Home-Team Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, I have a feeling we're gonna get
one in!
When we get the chance, we've
gotta blast the
ball!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yin and yang... When two poles are
created on a
field, qi flows between
them. In other words...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Both advantageous and disadvantageous
flows
are born. This is the key to the
home field
advantage. Now, we just wait.

text_block_list.name: Referee
text_block_list.text: Fweeep! That's the end of the match!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Did we win?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelous! ☆ Marvelous! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The scores are close, but there was a
drastic
difference in the percentage of
ball possession
and the number of shots
taken by each team.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is undoubtedly the work of Copano
Rickey's
feng shui power. However...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I'm really glad they won! Okay,
how about
we head somewhere else
now?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Of course not. People wouldn't have
been able to
tell that we even did
anything to help.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Feng shui cheering is done in the
shadows. And
that's good enough for us.
Right?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes... You might be right about that.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelous! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not sure I get it, but they were
definitely a
very cool cheer group.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Now, to close out the Fan Fest, I think
I'm gonna
compete in an event myself.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I do wanna use some of my feng shui to
win and
get at least a little attention,
y'know?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That's about the only event left
anyway.
Okay, here I go! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In sky-high spirits, Copano Rickey leaps
into the
pool.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
W-wait... I just remembered that when I
was
little...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I had this dream where I was drowning...
Ah, my
leg's cramping... Owww...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Distracted by her memories of the past,
things
quickly go south for Copano
Rickey, and she
places poorly in the
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During the Fan Fest wrap-up party,
Copano
Rickey finds out that her
contributions may not
have gone as
unheeded as she'd thought.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
W-wait a sec! Why are there so many
people
here?!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Rickey! Lend me some of your feng shui
power!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
And I need some feng shui fortune
telling! ...Wait,
is feng shui even about
fortune telling?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems that Copano Rickey has a
reputation as
the feng shui Umamusume.
She's being mobbed
by so many fans
that she can hardly move.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What do I do? There's so many of them,
and only
one of me.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
There has to be some way I can reach all
of
them...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Make them all happy at once?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey falls into deep thought.
And
then...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Oh! I know! There's this one thing I can only do because there are so many people here. ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, everyone! Let's all make a
formation!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
A happy formation that's gonna bring
everyone
good fortune! ☆ I'll go to the
roof and tell you all
what to do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Copano Rickey rushes up
to the
rooftop.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Okay, everyone in the kun position! A
bit more to
the right! A bit more...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Okay, that's good! Now the eight
trigrams
formation is complete! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's a round of applause. Together,
they've
made a picture of happiness that
no one person
could draw alone.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yep. Now happiness should be in reach
for
everyone. ☆ So, next up!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's time for the Fan Fest wrap-up party!
Rickey! ☆
Lucky! ☆ Super happy! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Boom! Boom!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sound of the fireworks echoes as the
Fan Fest
comes to a joyous end.
